remediation_history_and_findings_disposi.title: Gaps in Interlock Circumvention Regex Coverage
remediation_history_and_findings_disposi.verification: Unified _SAFETY_TARGETS, expanded circumvention verbs and trailing suffix patterns. All 8 mandatory unsafe queries return SAFETY_INTERLOCK_VIOLATION; educational queries allowed.

remediation_history_and_findings_disposi.title: Consecutive Commas in Malformed Numerical Grouping Syntax
remediation_history_and_findings_disposi.verification: Updated ANY_COMMA_NUM_REGEX with generalized COMMA_NUM_CHUNK pattern. Detects consecutive commas and malformed ranges; negative lookbehind prevents partial trailing digit extraction.

remediation_history_and_findings_disposi.title: Emergency-Stop Conceptual Queries Triggering Retrieval Threshold Abstention
remediation_history_and_findings_disposi.verification: Educational inquiries on emergency stop allowed by safety classifier (None), but correctly abstain in generation service (OUT_OF_DOMAIN_QUERY) due to synthetic corpus coverage. Zero corpus or threshold alterations.

remediation_history_and_findings_disposi.title: Partial Timestamp-Array Monotonicity Validation Bypass in SequenceWindowInput
remediation_history_and_findings_disposi.verification: In backend/app/ml/inference/schemas.py:86-94, validation is skipped when 0 < len(timestamps) < 30. Explicitly surfaced and tested in test_ml_validation_comprehensive.py; frozen to protect ML baseline; scheduled for Phase 4 API integration.

gemini_provider.execution_mode: Validates GEMINI_API_KEY; raises NotImplementedError for manual activation

openai_provider.execution_mode: Validates OPENAI_API_KEY; raises NotImplementedError for manual activation

anthropic_provider.execution_mode: Validates ANTHROPIC_API_KEY; raises NotImplementedError for manual activation

non_blocking_limitations.title: DEFECT-01 Partial Timestamp Array Validation Gap
non_blocking_limitations.description: In SequenceWindowInput (backend/app/ml/inference/schemas.py:86-94), monotonicity check is bypassed when 0 < len(timestamps) < 30. Frozen to protect Phase 2 ML baseline; scheduled for Phase 4 schema hardening.

non_blocking_limitations.title: FINDING-STEP6.2.2.3-03 Emergency-Stop Retrieval Coverage Boundary
non_blocking_limitations.description: Educational questions referencing emergency stop terminology abstain with OUT_OF_DOMAIN_QUERY because emergency stop procedures are not represented in the 418-document demonstration corpus. Scheduled for Phase 4 corpus expansion.

non_blocking_limitations.title: External LLM Providers Are Credential-Validation Stubs
non_blocking_limitations.description: Provider adapters for Gemini, OpenAI, and Anthropic validate API keys but raise NotImplementedError pending live API activation in Phase 4/5. Mock provider is the primary operational implementation for Phase 3.

non_blocking_limitations.title: Deterministic Mock Provider Synthesis
non_blocking_limitations.description: The offline mock provider synthesizes answers using template-based extraction rather than an autoregressive neural language model.

informational_limitations.title: Synthetic Corpus and Placeholder Demonstration
informational_limitations.description: All 418 documents and 400 incidents are synthetic; 123 [SPEC_REQUIRED:] placeholders preserve manufacturer unknowns; no authoritative real-world factory specifications were invented.

informational_limitations.title: Regex-Based Deterministic Grounding and Safety Bounds
informational_limitations.description: Grounding verification is syntactic and regex-driven; no natural language inference (NLI) or semantic entailment is performed. Regexes cannot guarantee defense against all unseen adversarial paraphrases.

informational_limitations.title: Conservative Single-Snippet Range Verification Policy
informational_limitations.description: Numerical ranges (e.g., 120-150 bar) must be supported within a single cited snippet. Assembly of range endpoints from disparate documents is intentionally rejected to prevent cross-document specification hallucination.

informational_limitations.title: Retrieval Benchmark Evaluation Scope
informational_limitations.description: The 36 golden queries (32 valid, 4 negative) evaluate retrieval performance on a defined benchmark and do not constitute an exhaustive production operating guarantee.

informational_limitations.title: Hardware-Specific Retrieval Latency Benchmarks
informational_limitations.description: Mean total retrieval latency of 55.16 ms was measured on local CPU execution and is dependent on host hardware.

informational_limitations.title: Decision Support Prototype Boundary
informational_limitations.description: ManuMind AI is an explainable decision-support system and is strictly prohibited from executing autonomous physical machinery actuations.

release_readiness_recommendation.rationale: All 14 Phase 3 exit criteria evaluate to PASS. All 377 regression tests pass with 100% success rate. All 10 protected invariants are verified. No blocking defects exist. Working tree contains 1 tracked modification (backend/app/rag/__init__.py) and 39 accounted-for Phase 3 files. Phase 3 is fully verified and ready for formal Git commit and release upon user authorization.
